evals.prompt: Curate content from inventory JSON — 5 approved assets with tags; pick best 2 for next week, date 2026-07-14.
evals.expected_output: Ranked selection with rationale per asset, seasonal and brand alignment, diversity across subjects.
assertions: Returns ranked selection from provided inventory (does not invent assets)
Rationale references brand voice and seasonal context
Does not write captions or analyse single images
Does not schedule or publish to Instagram
